blocks.text: Data saaf hone ke baad aksar use aisi shakal (format) mein badalna padta hai jis par kaam karna aasan ho. Is transformation mein data ko doosre format mein badalna, naye columns banana ya data ko naye tareeqe se organize karna shamil ho sakta hai. Yeh changes (tabdeeliyan) data ko analysis ya modeling ke liye zyada suitable (theek, kaam ka) banati hain.
Misal: Grades ke saaf record ko behtar analysis ke liye badalna pad sakta hai. Maslan har student ke alag grades dikhane ki bajaye data... (kitab ka jumla yahin adhoora reh gaya hai).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab yeh jumla poora nahi karti. Aisi transformation ki ek aam misal yeh hai ke har student ki alag qataar ki bajaye har class ka average grade dikhaya jaye, ya marks se naya “percentage” column banaya jaye. (Yeh misal hamari taraf se hai.)
Yeh program marks se naya percentage column banata hai, yani data ko naye format mein badalta hai. total_marks ya marks badal kar Run karein aur naya column dekhein.

names = ["Ali", "Sara", "Hina", "Bilal"]
marks = [68, 75, 54, 81]
total_marks = 90

print("Name    Marks  Percentage")
for name, m in zip(names, marks):
    percentage = m / total_marks * 100      # new column made from marks
    print(f"{name:<7} {m:>5}  {percentage:9.1f}%")

blocks.prompt: Data transformation ki ek misal dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Marks se naya “percentage” column banana, ya students ke grades ki list ko har class ke average grade ki table mein badalna.

items: Transformation: saaf data ka format badalna, naye columns banana ya naye tareeqe se organize karna.
